english.description: You have completed the task of the Valkyrie Hilda, defeating the mighty Veritory the  Blood and his army of dragons, and now carry with honor the title of Dragonslayer!
english.name: bloody_eyes

english.description: You have overcome a huge dragon Rikshenassitrax and took from him a powerful artifact called the Tear of the Dragon. This grants you the right to truly be called a Gambler!
english.name: bone_hunter

english.description: You have passed your trials and became a full-fledged warrior of the village.
english.name: north_sentinel

english.description: Kael-shot, the first blade, in gratitude for your service to the King of Merlassar, has taken you into the ranks of the elven order of the Blossoming Blades!
english.name: master_of_blades

english.description: You helped Ingvar Kopperrad and found the survivors of Fastland. In gratitude, he has awarded your faithfulness with an appropriate title.
english.name: burning_lights

english.description: The elf Lin Evere has given you a branch of myrtle as a symbol of peace and friendship. Even though you still feel like a stranger in the company of Children of the Star, it is better to have elves as allies than enemies!
english.name: at_home_among_strangers

english.description: You defeated the giant Loki in a fair fight. No one ever before has beaten him in a contest of strength, so he has offered you his friendship, an honor impossible to refuse.
english.name: friend_of_giants

english.description: You helped Captain Tigg and his friends from Undershore Brotherhood. For your service, a special brotherhood council unanimously voted to award you the title of Friend of the Pirates.
english.name: tactful_fighter

english.description: You helped the strange fiery creature Zahar defeat his opponent, and he awarded you with this title. Now all creatures made of fire and flames will know that you are a true friend!
english.name: lord_fire

english.description: After the battle with Runorm, you were swamped by the Dark Portal and ejected in an unknown place. It is no wonder that the locals look at you askance.
english.name: strange_stranger

english.description: You have been awarded honorary membership in the Free Brotherhood of Isterreng, making you a real sea wolf. Yo, ho, ho!
english.name: sea_dog

english.description: On Freedom Islands you defeated the necromancer Sirius Pale, and for this the orc Hagyr Bigaxe proclaimed that henceforth you shall be known as "Strong as Hagyr!"
english.name: proven_storm

english.description: You have completed the task of the Valkyrie Gudrida, by destroying the army of orcs that were threatening your island. This earned you the greenskin nickname "Uck Judg" that is, the Black Death.
english.name: conversing_with_death

english.description: You have completed the task of the Valkyrie Regina, bringning her 10 giant creatures, and can now rightfully be called the Lord of the Giants.
english.name: conversing_with_wind

english.description: You saved the Royal Egg of the dragon Massalatrix, and were awarded the title "Defender of the Ice." Now you are a great friend to the Ice Dragons.
english.name: connoisseur_of_ice

english.description: After the battle with your brother, you fled your native island, and now your destiny, it seems, is to roam inhospitable islands on the cold and barren sea.
english.name: hostage_betrayal

english.description: Thanks to your efforts, the artist Eye Vaz the Orc finally wrote his masterpiece, and has become reknown throughout the world.
english.name: ghost_rider

english.description: You have helped to free the demon Lurfu from the astral captivity in boiling lava, and for this he rewarded you with the title of Astral Rider.
english.name: roaming_in_the_astral_plane

english.description: You have completed the task of Korn Digor, and cleared New Kordar of the undead hordes. You can now rightfully be called "d'hukha marud" -- Border Guard!
english.name: border_guards

english.description: You have completed the task of the King of Asvald, and brought peace and tranquility to the island of South Vinland. You now carry the title of Jarl Protector, defender of the Vikings!
english.name: defender_light

english.description: You overcame the magicians of Arlania and took possession of the Staff of Starlight! Woe to anyone who would stand in your way, as your title clearly suggests!
english.name: malefikary

english.description: You cut out the heart from the chest of the evil necromancer Ksaltotun, and his dark blood has forever tarnished your blade. Let this blade be a sign of your courage and strength!
english.name: dark_blade

english.description: You have returned Taor to sanity and killed the rebellious vikings of Chukata and Gronnum! Now everyone knows that it is impossible to resist you!
english.name: subordinating_force

english.description: You have refused to side with the Prince Consort Guilford, and now he is your sworn enemy. Neither of you shall rest until one of you is put out to sea on a fiery funeral ship!
english.name: sworn_enemy

english.description: You performed a great service for the old pirate Simon Danziker, having found and buried the remains of his cabin boy, and destroying the pack of wild wolves who attacked the poor youth.
english.name: pathfinder_snowy_mountains

english.description: You won the Dwarven High Hammer, and now you are known across all the dwarven lands as "bhak udrut" -- the Heavy Striker! It has quite a ring to it!
english.name: heavy_striker

english.description: You killed four leaders of the undead and took possession of their weapons. That alone is reason enough to be proud to wear this title!
english.name: destroying_the_undead

english.description: You have completed the task of the Valkyrie Christa, and for your generosity you are now a favorite of the gods.
english.name: disciple_of_the_gods

english.description: You have completed the task of the Valkyrie Mista, by returning to her the weapon of Tyr, stolen by Fenrir. For this you have earned the title of Favorite of Ragnarok!
english.name: a_favorite_of_ragnarok

english.description: You left the poisoned Ele Taera to die in the cave. Of course you have a heart -- as cold as a piece of granite!
english.name: heart_of_flint

english.description: You defeated the dragon Glaurmur the Dazzling, and now the "white bird of happiness" will no longer lure unsuspecting travelers into his deadly trap.
english.name: thief_of_souls

english.description: You killed the giant Gloomgnaw, and captain of the palace guard, Renli Swann, has granted you this title in recognition of this great achievement.
english.name: killer_giants

english.description: You killed the rebel Selmy Boros and his rebel troops have returned to their barracks. To reward you for your services to Darion, you have been granted this title.
english.name: keeper_of_the_order

english.description: You have entered an alliance with Xeona, leader of the demonic army, and enlisted his support in the upcoming battle with the usurper Prince Consort Guilford.
english.name: demon_talker

english.description: You have helped with the griffin Sirranu with the dragon Massalatrix, and he awarded you this title. Now all the Griffins know that you are their friend!
english.name: friend_of_griffins

english.description: You completed the quest of the demon Xeona, and bent the four other demon lords to her will. In recognition of your achievements, Xeona bestowed upon you this title.
english.name: demon_master

english.description: At the request of the magician-daemon Arkton, you tracked down and killed a strange creature of fire and smoke. Arkton gave you this title in recognition of your services.
english.name: elemental_overlord

schinese.description: 获得成就“生命之祸”、“斗士”、‘屠夫’、“酷炫战士”和“惹事生非”。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_winner_1

schinese.description: 达成成就「瓦尔哈拉宠儿」、「高阶法师」、「疯狂勇气」、「自信满满」及「鲁莽斗士」。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_nerd_1

schinese.description: 获得成就“贪婪者”、“收藏家”、‘无情者’、“业余珠宝商”和“死亡之祸”。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_adventurer_1

schinese.name: medal_achievement_true_warrior_1

schinese.name: medal_achievement_nice_player_1

schinese.name: medal_achievement_inspired_1

schinese.description: 将角色提升至最高等级。

schinese.description: 以最少盟友击败埃里克。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_erik_winner_1

schinese.description: 15回合内击败不死蜘蛛及其全部部队。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_arachnofob_1

schinese.description: 击败鲁诺姆并关闭黑暗之门，部队损失不超过30%，或零伤亡完成。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_enemy_dead_1

schinese.description: 最终战中不使用法术书击败吉尔福德。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_almost_sacred_1

schinese.description: 以不可能难度通关游戏。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_hardcore_gamer_1

schinese.description: 收集全套物品。
schinese.name: medal_achievement_connoisseur_of_antiquities_1

schinese.description: 你已完成女武神希尔达的使命，击败了强大的血龙维里托里及其龙族大军，如今荣耀地背负着“屠龙者”的称号！
schinese.name: bloody_eyes

schinese.description: 你战胜了巨龙瑞克希纳西特拉克斯，从它身上夺取了名为“龙之泪”的强大神器。这赋予你真正被称为“赌徒”的权利！
schinese.name: bone_hunter

schinese.description: 你通过了考验，成为村庄的正式战士。
schinese.name: north_sentinel

schinese.description: 凯尔之刃——第一剑，为感谢你对梅拉萨尔国王的效忠，已将你纳入精灵“绽放之刃”剑术团的行列！
schinese.name: master_of_blades

schinese.description: 你协助英格瓦·科珀拉德寻获了法斯特兰幸存者。为表彰你的忠诚，他特此授予你相称的尊号。
schinese.name: burning_lights

schinese.description: 精灵林·埃弗尔赠予你一枝桃金娘，象征和平与友谊。纵使在星之子族中你仍感疏离，但与精灵结盟总胜过为敌！
schinese.name: at_home_among_strangers

schinese.description: 你以公平较量击败了巨人洛基。此前无人能在力量比试中战胜他，故他主动献上友谊——这份殊荣令人无法拒绝。
schinese.name: friend_of_giants

schinese.description: 你协助蒂格船长及其“暗岸兄弟会”的伙伴们。为表彰你的功绩，兄弟会特别议会一致授予你“海盗之友”称号。
schinese.name: tactful_fighter

schinese.description: 你协助奇异的火焰生物扎哈尔击败对手，因而获此称号。今往后所有火焰造物皆知晓——你是真正的盟友！
schinese.name: lord_fire

schinese.description: 与鲁诺姆激战后，你被黑暗之门吞噬并抛至未知之地。当地人投来异样目光实属情理之中。
schinese.name: strange_stranger

schinese.description: 你获颁伊斯特伦自由兄弟会荣誉会员资格，正式成为真正的海狼。哟呵呵！
schinese.name: sea_dog

schinese.description: 在自由群岛击败亡灵法师天狼星·苍白后，兽人哈吉尔·大斧宣告你从此被尊为\强悍者
schinese.name: proven_storm

schinese.description: 你完成了女武神古德里达的任务，摧毁了威胁你岛屿的兽人军团。这使你获得了绿皮族人“乌克·朱格”的绰号，即黑死病。
schinese.name: conversing_with_death

schinese.description: 你完成了女武神蕾吉娜的任务，为她献上十头巨兽，如今当之无愧地成为巨人领主。
schinese.name: conversing_with_wind

schinese.description: 你救下了巨龙玛萨拉蒂克斯的王室圣卵，获封“冰原守护者”之名。
schinese.name: connoisseur_of_ice

schinese.description: 与兄长决战后，你逃离了故土岛屿，如今命运似乎注定要在寒冷贫瘠之海的荒芜岛屿间漂泊。
schinese.name: hostage_betrayal

schinese.description: 托你的福，兽人艺术家瓦兹之眼终于完成传世杰作，名扬天下。
schinese.name: ghost_rider

schinese.description: 你协助恶魔卢尔芙挣脱星界熔岩牢笼，因此获封“星界骑士”称号。
schinese.name: roaming_in_the_astral_plane

schinese.description: 你完成科恩·迪戈尔的使命，为新科达尔驱逐亡灵大军。如今你当之无愧被称为“d'hukha marud”——边境守卫！
schinese.name: border_guards

schinese.description: 你完成了阿斯瓦尔德国王的使命，为南维京岛带来和平与安宁。如今你肩负“领主守护者”之名，成为维京人的守护者！
schinese.name: defender_light

schinese.description: 你击败了阿尔拉尼亚的魔法师，夺取了星光法杖！正如你的称号昭示——任何阻挡你的人都将遭遇厄运！
schinese.name: malefikary

schinese.description: 你从邪恶亡灵法师克萨洛顿胸膛中剖出心脏，其黑暗之血已永恒玷污你的利刃。让此剑成为你勇毅的象征！
schinese.name: dark_blade

schinese.description: 你使陶尔恢复神智，剿灭了楚卡塔与格罗努姆的叛乱维京人！今世众生皆知，无人能与你抗衡！
schinese.name: subordinating_force

schinese.description: 你拒绝效忠王储吉尔福德，如今他已成为你不共戴天的仇敌。除非其中一人被送上烈焰葬船漂流大海，否则你们永无宁日！
schinese.name: sworn_enemy

schinese.description: 你为老海盗西蒙·丹齐克立下大功：寻回并安葬了他的见习水手遗骸，更歼灭了袭击那可怜少年的狼群。
schinese.name: pathfinder_snowy_mountains

schinese.description: 你赢得了矮人圣锤，如今在所有矮人领地皆以“bhak udrut”——重锤者之名闻名！这称号听起来真够响亮！
schinese.name: heavy_striker

schinese.description: 你击杀了四名亡灵首领并夺取了他们的武器。仅凭此功，配戴此称号便已足够骄傲！
schinese.name: destroying_the_undead

schinese.description: 你完成了女武神克丽丝塔的委托，因这份慷慨而成为诸神青睐的对象。
schinese.name: disciple_of_the_gods

schinese.description: 你完成了女武神米斯塔的委托，将被芬里尔盗走的提尔神兵归还。为此你赢得了“诸神黄昏宠儿”的称号！
schinese.name: a_favorite_of_ragnarok

schinese.description: 你将中毒的艾蕾·泰拉弃于洞穴任其死亡。你当然有颗心——冷若花岗岩！
schinese.name: heart_of_flint

schinese.description: 你击败了炫目巨龙格劳穆尔，从此“幸福白鸟”再无法将无辜旅人引向致命陷阱。
schinese.name: thief_of_souls

schinese.description: 你斩杀了巨人格鲁姆格纳，宫廷卫队长伦利·斯旺特此授予此称号以表彰壮举。
schinese.name: killer_giants

schinese.description: 你剿灭叛军首领塞尔米·博罗斯，其部众已重归军营。因你对达里昂的卓越贡献，特此授予此称号。
schinese.name: keeper_of_the_order

schinese.description: 你与恶魔军团首领克索娜缔结同盟，获得其在即将到来的篡位者吉尔福德亲王之战中的支援。
schinese.name: demon_talker

schinese.description: 你协助狮鹫西拉努击败巨龙玛萨拉蒂克斯，因此获得此称号。如今所有狮鹫皆知你是它们的朋友！
schinese.name: friend_of_griffins

schinese.description: 你完成了恶魔泽奥娜的任务，使其余四位恶魔领主臣服于她。为表彰你的功绩，泽奥娜授予你此称号。
schinese.name: demon_master

schinese.description: 应魔术师恶魔阿克顿之请，你追踪并击杀了火焰与烟雾构成的奇异生物。阿克顿为表彰你的功绩授予你此称号。
schinese.name: elemental_overlord
